title: Admission
message:
Dear Parents and Guardians,
We are pleased to announce that admission for the Academic Session 2027 is now open at Cambridge International School, Satkhira!
  
We offer a modern learning environment, experienced faculty, and holistic development for your child.

title: Welcome
message:
🎉 Welcome to Cambridge International School, Satkhira!

Dear Students, Parents, and Guardians,

A warm welcome to the new academic journey at Cambridge International School, Satkhira!

We are delighted to welcome our students to a new chapter filled with learning, growth, friendship, and exciting opportunities. Our mission is to inspire young minds, nurture creativity, and build a strong foundation for a brighter future.

📚 Knowledge is Power, Education is Key.

Let us work together to make this academic journey meaningful, successful, and memorable.

We wish all our students a wonderful and successful school year!

Warm regards,
Cambridge International School, Satkhira
📍 Mehedibag, Rosulpur, Satkhira, Bangladesh
